'''Oricon''' was a volcanic [[Moon/Legends|moon]] with breathable atmosphere orbiting around a green planet in the [[Oricon system/Legends|Oricon system]] in [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva Sector]], [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located just outside the [[Seat of The Empire]], well of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It was strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]].<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Oricon}}</ref>

==Description==
Once-lifeless rocky orb changed when [[Dread Masters]] made it their home, bringing species from all over the Galaxy to corrupt and experiment on them. It has also become a starship graveyard for both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republican]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] vessels poised to attack the Dread Master's fortress and torn apart by Dread Masters' dark influence.<ref name="codex" />

==History==
An insignificant world, it was once home to [[Darth Vitus]], before its location was lost to the wider galaxy. Vitus experimented with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] on the world, creating monsters strong with the dark side. During the age of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tracked the world down from clues in a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], eventually leading them to [[Darth Vitus's compound]].<ref name="Behind the Threat">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/BtT5antiheros|series=Behind the Threat: The Sith|text=Part 5: Antiheroes}}</ref>

During the era of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] tasked six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]&mdash;[[Bestia]], [[Tyrans]], [[Brontes]], [[Styrak]], [[Calphayus]], and [[Raptus]]&mdash;with studying the powerful [[Phobis devices]], and sent them to Oricon to do so. When they emerged from their research as the mysterious and powerful [[Dread Masters]], they declared their intention to make Oricon their home, and with the Emperor's blessing, they used thousands of slaves to construct the [[Dread Fortress]] as their citadel.<ref name="TOR RotHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic War]], the Dread Masters' rebellion against the Empire was brought to end in the [[Dread War]] on Oricon, where the remaining Dread Masters were slain within their fortress.<ref name="TOR RotHC" />
